name: Electrician
tip: List licence number if your state requires it on paperwork, and separate materials from labour so clients can see what they paid for.

name: Plumber
tip: Itemise parts and labour separately and note any warranty period on installed parts.

name: Cleaner
tip: For recurring jobs, add the service date range to the description, e.g. 'Weekly clean 1–28 Oct'.

name: Photographer
tip: State usage/licence terms for the images in your notes so the client knows what they bought.

name: Graphic designer
tip: Reference the quote or proposal number and the deliverables so the invoice matches what was agreed.

name: Web developer
tip: For milestone billing, name the milestone and the percentage of the project it represents.

name: Personal trainer
tip: Include the session dates covered so clients can reconcile against their bookings.

name: Tutor
tip: Many tutoring services are not GST-registered — if you're under the threshold, issue a plain 'Invoice', not a 'Tax invoice'.

name: Consultant
tip: For sales of $1,000 or more the buyer's identity or ABN must appear on a tax invoice.

name: Landscaper
tip: Show materials by unit (m³, tonnes) so quantities are clear.

name: Painter
tip: Note the rooms/areas painted in the description to avoid disputes.

name: Carpenter
tip: Reference your quote number and any approved variations.

name: Mobile hairdresser
tip: For walk-in clients a receipt is usually enough; a tax invoice is needed if the client asks or the sale exceeds $82.50 incl. GST.

name: Copywriter
tip: State the word counts and revision rounds included.

name: Videographer
tip: Specify deliverables (formats, lengths) and licence terms in the notes.

name: Bookkeeper
tip: Name the period covered, e.g. 'September 2026'.

name: Mobile mechanic
tip: Include the vehicle registration and odometer reading in the description.

name: Dog groomer
tip: Add the pet's name to the line description — clients appreciate it and it helps records.

name: Removalist
tip: State start/finish times so hourly charges are transparent.

name: Virtual assistant
tip: Attach or reference a timesheet for hourly work.
